h1: Diabetes medications: every class, how each works, and where amylin drugs fit
dek: A complete list of type 2 diabetes medications in one table: how each class lowers blood sugar, its A1C and weight effect, whether it causes hypoglycemia, pill or injection, and example names, with how the 2026 ADA Standards choose between them.
scope: Informational. 'Best medicine' queries are commercial-tagged by Semrush but answered informationally as how guidelines choose; no product, price or seller content.

competitors.gap: List of drug names by class without the ADA efficacy, weight and hypoglycemia grading side by side, and nothing on amylin drugs or CagriSema trial data
Oral agents only; injectables, the 2026 guideline logic and amylin analogues are outside its scope
Patient overview by class; no per-claim citations to labels or trials and no investigational drugs
Narrative by class; no single comparison table and no 2026 guideline changes

information_gain: The only list that puts every class, including the amylin analogue pramlintide, on one row each with the ADA 2026 efficacy, weight and hypoglycemia grading, cites the FDA label warning for each, and shows the three published REIMAGINE trials of CagriSema in type 2 diabetes.
serp_format_rewarded: Long list/table of classes with names (featured snippet and image pack), PAA answers on best medicine, OTC and side effects
